deadline.value: Apply by December 1, 2026 to be considered for all university and department funding.
deadline.quote: The application deadline for Fall 2027 admission is December 1, 2026.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: You are admitted only with a research advisor identified, so contact faculty well before applying.
supervisor.quote: We can only admit applicants if they have a research advisor (and ideally a research project) identified. Therefore, an applicant should contact one or more faculty members in the Department of Geology & Geophysics well before submitting an application.

funding.value: PhD offers are made only with a commitment of full financial support.
funding.quote: Our department only makes offers of admission to Ph.D. applicants with a commitment of full financial support.

entry_route.value: A four-year bachelor's is enough (96-hour PhD); master's holders apply for the 64-hour PhD.
entry_route.quote: A Master of Science is not required to apply as a Ph.D. student. Students with an M.S. should apply for the Ph.D.-64 hour program while B.S. or B.A. degree holders should apply for the Ph.D.-96 hour program.

gre_general.value: GRE scores are neither required nor considered.
gre_general.quote: At this time, we do not require applicants to report GRE scores, and we will not consider GRE scores in our holistic application-review process.

notes: Minimum GPA 3.0 on a 4.0 scale. Department GAT funding is offered with fall admission only.
